description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Katalyst Space is an American technology company focused on dynamic space operations and robotic space vehicles. The company is seeking a Software Engineer I to create and maintain modeling and simulation software, convert engineering data into code, support AI&T and SITL testing tools, and verify models and simulations against hardware.
Modeling and Simulation Engineer Building Hardware-Validated Models and Software-in-the-Loop Testing Tools

Responsibilities:
• Help create models and sims for cross domain uses
• Learn how to convert data sheets into code
• Aid the team in creating AI&T testing tool suite to aid in SITL testing
• Maintain and create coding environment
• Verify model and sims against hardware

Requirements:
• 1-3 Years of experience in modeling and simulation for complex aerospace missions
• 2-3 years working in C++ and Python
• Strong understanding of object-oriented software development practices
• Ability to understand new challenges quickly, formulate a plan, get buy-in, and execute
• Understanding complex distributed systems, and how the components you design and deliver will fit into those larger systems
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• BS in Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Computer Science or closely related STEM field

Preferred:
• Experience simulating in 6-DOF relative motion and RPOC
• Contributed to previous digital twin efforts
• Working knowledge in multiple at least one subsystems such as GNC, Flight Dynamics, EPS, Propulsion, etc
• Previous experience in simulations frameworks such as Basalisk, STK, GMAT
• Working knowledge of distributed compute frameworks
